description: Backend API routes for patient portal: Create patient-scoped routes for viewing own appointments, lab results, prescriptions, and requesting appointments. These routes check Patient role permission and use RLS to enforce data access.
steps: Create backend/src/routes/patientPortal.ts with GET /patient-portal/appointments (requireHospitalPermission APPOINTMENTS_READ_OWN), GET /patient-portal/lab-results (LAB_READ_OWN), GET /patient-portal/prescriptions (PRESCRIPTIONS_READ_OWN), POST /patient-portal/appointments/request (APPOINTMENTS_REQUEST)

Create backend/src/routes/patientPortal.handlers.ts with handler functions: getMyAppointments (joins appointments with doctors/departments, filters via RLS), getMyLabResults (joins lab_results -> lab_orders -> encounters, filters via RLS), getMyPrescriptions (joins prescriptions -> prescription_items -> encounters, filters via RLS), requestAppointment (creates appointment with status='pending')
Add routes to backend/src/constants/routes.ts under patientPortal key: myAppointments, myLabResults, myPrescriptions, requestAppointment
Register patientPortal router in backend/src/routes/index.ts: import and app.use(patientPortalRouter)

Create backend/src/services/patientPortal/ directory with PatientPortalService.ts containing business logic: queryMyAppointments, queryMyLabResults, queryMyPrescriptions, createAppointmentRequest (all use req.supabase user-scoped client)
Split handlers to use service functions if any handler file approaches 100 lines
acceptance_criteria: Four new API routes exist under /api/v1/patient-portal/
Each route has requireHospitalPermission middleware with appropriate patient permission
Handlers query via req.supabase (user-scoped client, RLS applies automatically)
All queries join necessary tables to return complete data (appointment includes doctor name, lab result includes test name, prescription includes medication details)
All backend files are under 100 lines
verification: Run TypeScript build: cd backend && npm run build - must succeed
Start backend dev server: cd backend && npm run dev
Test with curl or Postman: GET /api/v1/patient-portal/appointments with valid JWT for a patient user - should return patient's appointments
Test: POST /api/v1/patient-portal/appointments/request with patient JWT and valid appointment data - should create appointment with status='pending'
Verify all files in backend/src/routes/patientPortal* and backend/src/services/patientPortal/ are under 100 lines each
